taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said expectations are unclear. What is happening?

Aiyoh, being week 3 here already, today my bus from Butterworth also jammed and came super late lah, rushing all the way here only to freeze because the office aircon is like Genting Highlands, damn cold one! Then my SAP access also came very late last week, so blur already. Now my team lead is always stuck in meetings and on calls, cannot find him to ask anything. Plus the daily processing quota here is super high, confirm cannot catch up sometimes, but luckily downstairs canteen nasi lemak sedap lah, can buy to cure my stress. But honestly, the main real issue bothering me is that nobody actually gave me the proper vendor master rules yet, so every time I process invoices, confirm kena rejected by the system, and then I have to waste so much time redoing everything all over again without knowing what went wrong!
What happens when the system rejects the invoices?

Aiyoh, when the system rejects the invoices, confirm panic lah because since my SAP access came late and nobody gave me proper vendor master rules, I got zero clue what went wrong! The screen just pop up some bombastic error code, so I must manually re-key everything from scratch all over again, which is super mafan and eats up so much time when our daily processing quota is already damn high. By that time my brain already jaded and blur like sotong, plus sitting here freezing in this Genting-highlands office aircon makes it worse. I want to ask my team lead but he is still stuck in those endless Zoom calls all day, cannot disturb him one. So blur-blur I just try to fix it anyhow, kena reject again, then stomach start to growling thinking of the nice canteen nasi lemak downstairs that I cannot go buy yet because of this mountain of rejections, confirm stress max already lah!

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire experienced late system access, unavailable leadership, missing vendor master rules causing repeated invoice rejections, high processing quotas, and a cold office environment.
